title: メジロマックイーン登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last, Mejiro McQueen's journey to compete in the Twinkle Series begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm super psyched for it as well. But first, I need to head to the cafeteria for a bite to eat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Such a wonderful smell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: There's a weightiness to it, yet it's delicate as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's nice and strong. It might not even need sugar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (That's Mejiro Ryan, a member of the noted Mejiro family. She's athletic and radiates energy.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The academy's cafe is rather elaborate, isn't it? There are so many flavors on the menu.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (This is Mejiro Dober, also a member of the Mejiro family. She's a bit hard to please.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: L-look, look! They're from the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: They're having a high-class conversation! Just how I thought they'd be!
choice_data_list: (Now that I look at them again, they really do have an impressive aura!)
(Now that I look at them again, they really do have an impressive aura!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And last but not least, my trainee—Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her in this light, I can really sense the noble air she emits.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But, are you sure you don't want a chocolate pudding crepe, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? …Yes, I'm sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm perfectly fine! I-I brought my own special dessert, you see!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Special dessert?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-yes. I made it myself with nuts in place of flour.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Low in sugar and high in protein, it's very nutritious. Above all else, the exquisite flavor solidifies it as an exceptional dessert.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's wonderful. In that case, I'm sure you wouldn't mind if I had one of those crepes myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course, go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a closer look at the dessert Mejiro McQueen has and realize it's from a recipe I once taught her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to be working hard to reach her goals, just like always.
choice_data_list: You're giving it your all, aren't you?
You're giving it your all, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's McQueen's trainer. Hi!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're right. McQueen has been working hard nonstop lately!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Having set a goal to conquer the Tenno Sho, it's only natural for me to work hard to reach it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Not to mention, my debut is very soon, which means I must brace myself and focus all the more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. I hope you'll accompany me with the intention of doing the same.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Still, it's gonna be a long time before you compete in the Tenno Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Shouldn't you be aiming for the Classics first?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, consider conquering the Tenno Sho my ultimate goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Before that, I plan to achieve success in the Classics and make steady progress toward the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahh. Then I guess that means we'll be meeting at the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, I'm not gonna lose! I've had my sights on the Classic Triple Crown for a long time now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm well aware of just how hard you've been working.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I won't be going easy on you either. I'll be giving the Classics everything I have!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's both give it our best shot! …Oh, it looks like Dober is back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, awesome! There really is chocolate pudding on top of the crepe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-what did you say?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks for bringing one for me too, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It was no trouble. No one else was in line. Well, I think I'll go ahead and dig in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gulp…
choice_data_list: You wish you'd gotten one after all, don't you?
You wish you'd gotten one after all, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, uh, no, that's not it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm not fighting to restrain myself or anything of the sort!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case, Mejiro McQueen and I have begun aiming for the Tenno Sho in earnest!
